dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Day Quil was surrendered into care as a stray, so his past behavior in a home environment is unknown. Day Quil has not acclimated well to the shelter environment, only allowing for minimal handling. During his intake, he was stiff-bodied but tolerated the intake tasks. Day Quil remains fearful and avoidant of interaction and handling and has escalated to snapping at handlers. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement in an adult-only home through a New Hope Rescue partner that is able to give him the time and space to decompress and acclimate at his own pace.
dog.name: Toffee
